title: Periodic Tilings of Cardinality Twice a Prime or Nine in Arbitrary Dimension
summary: We prove that every finite translational tile of $\mathbb Z^d$ of cardinality $2q$, where $q$ is an odd prime, or of cardinality nine admits a fully periodic tiling complement. The result holds in every dimension, regardless of the rank of the subgroup generated by the differences of points of the tile. The proofs combine coprime dilation, vanishing sums of roots of unity, and periodic two-colorings.
